title: ML Engineer — NLP
description:
Home Credit Bank Kazakhstan is hiring an NLP-focused ML Engineer to work on text understanding tasks across our customer support, document processing, and risk pipelines. You will train, fine-tune, and deploy NLP models that directly impact business operations.

Responsibilities:
— Build and fine-tune transformer-based models for classification, NER, and text generation
— Develop pipelines for processing Russian, Kazakh, and English text
— Fine-tune LLMs using PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA)
— Prepare and curate training datasets
— Deploy models to production using ONNX / TorchServe / Triton
— Monitor model performance and address data drift
— Collaborate with product teams to define ML use cases

Requirements:
— 2+ years of NLP / ML engineering experience
— Strong Python and PyTorch skills
— Hands-on experience with HuggingFace Transformers ecosystem
— Understanding of modern NLP architectures (BERT, T5, GPT family)
— Experience fine-tuning models on custom datasets
— Knowledge of evaluation metrics for NLP tasks
— Git, Docker, Linux

Nice to have: experience with multilingual models, knowledge distillation, model quantization, MLflow, experience working with Russian / Kazakh language data.
